title: Characteristic classes on a noncommutative background: a new approach
summary: We introduce analogues of partial derivatives with respect to the generators of the enveloping algebras U(gl(N)) and their q-deformations, the so-called modified reflection equation algebras. Using these quantum partial derivatives, we introduce the corresponding differential algebras, define the quantum de Rham operator, and exhibit the Leibniz rule for its action. Our Leibniz rule differs from its classical analogue and stems from the construction of a quantum double.
